observations.behavior: Adds a new environment variable, WEB_ANALYTICS_ACHIEVEMENT_QUERY_MAX_CONCURRENCY, with a default value of 4, used to configure concurrency limits for achievement queries.
observations.posthog_connection: This configuration allows PostHog to control the maximum number of concurrent achievement queries, preventing resource exhaustion during high-load scenarios.

observations.behavior: Imports the achievement query limiter, get_achievement_query_limiter, into the evaluators module.
observations.posthog_connection: This import is necessary to use the concurrency limiter in the achievement evaluation logic.

observations.behavior: Wraps the cumulative pageviews evaluation with the achievement query limiter, get_achievement_query_limiter().run(team_id=ctx.team.id).
observations.posthog_connection: This change ensures that the cumulative pageviews evaluation respects the configured concurrency limit, preventing resource exhaustion.
